label: ALOLA
arrive: Hau'oli in the sun. The new warehouse is a closed surf shop, and the sign still says ALOHA.
{brought} puts on sunglasses. "Boss, I think I live here now."
Down the beach, a crowd in skull hats is spray-painting a wall. A car with a white foundation logo drives past them very slowly.

owner.name: The town elders
owner.line: The kahuna's stage. Everyone comes on festival night.

owner.name: The ruin keeper
owner.line: Tapu Koko's old home. People leave offerings.

owner.name: Trainers on the route
owner.line: Kids with their first partner and a lot of sunscreen.

owner.name: The mall manager
owner.line: Three floors of souvenirs and a malasada stall.

owner.name: The surfers
owner.line: Surfboards, tourists, and boats that come in at night.

owner.name: Officer Jenny
owner.line: The island's only real police station.

owner.name: The concierge
owner.line: Every guest is rich and every guest is bored.

owner.name: The harbour master
owner.line: Ferries between all four islands.

owner.name: Professor Burnet
owner.line: She studies the holes in the sky.

owner.name: The stall owners
owner.line: Herbs, jewellery and old pearls.

owner.name: The grave keeper
owner.line: Old graves on a windy hill. Ghosts at sunset.

owner.name: Fishermen
owner.line: The quiet side of the island.

owner.name: The librarian
owner.line: Old Kanto-style roofs and older books.

owner.name: The garden tea house
owner.line: Tourists drink tea; locals watch the tourists.

owner.name: The cargo crew
owner.line: Cargo for the whole island.

owner.name: The 'butler'
owner.line: Guzma's mansion. Skull does what it likes here.

owner.name: The Mart clerk
owner.line: Shut, painted over, and still open if you knock.

owner.name: The taggers
owner.line: Every wall says SKULL. Every wall.

owner.name: The branch chief
owner.line: Pokémon in perfect white rooms. Too perfect.

owner.name: The receptionists
owner.line: Smiles, white uniforms, and a lift that needs a card.

owner.name: The ferry crew
owner.line: The only way on or off the island.

owner.name: The ranch owner
owner.line: Tauros and Miltank and a very old fence.

owner.name: The Battle Royal crowd
owner.line: Four Trainers in one ring. The crowd bets on all of them.

owner.name: Trainers on the hill
owner.line: Waterfalls and wishiwashi.

owner.name: The boat captains
owner.line: A village made of boats. Nobody owns land here.

owner.name: The canyon guides
owner.line: Dragon Pokémon live at the end of the canyon.

owner.name: The cook
owner.line: Fish soup and old stories.

owner.name: The lift crew
owner.line: The new Pokémon League sits on the summit.

owner.name: Snow climbers
owner.line: Snow on a tropical island. Climbers love it.

owner.name: The astronomer
owner.line: He looks at the stars. Also at the Ultra Wormholes.

business.name: Tide Song Hotel
business.text: Rich guests pay ₽400 more a week.

business.name: Konikoni Market
business.text: Cash stalls: ₽150 a week comes back clean.

business.name: Malie Garden
business.text: The Hero stops for tea. Every time.

business.name: Royal Avenue
business.text: Battle Royal bets wash ₽200 a week.

business.name: Floating Diner
business.text: Nobody talks on a boat: Heat −1 in Seafolk each week.

business.name: Po Town Mart
business.text: 2 Potions a week, if you knock.

business.name: Paniola Ranch
business.text: 2 bottles of Moomoo Milk a week.

writers.name: Kahuna's festival cook
writers.quote: {first} cooked for the festival every year. Never burned a thing.

writers.name: Ferry captain Kai
writers.quote: {first} crewed my ferry between islands. Good sea legs.

writers.name: Ruins guide Noelani
writers.quote: {first} sold stones at the market. Honest prices. Mostly.

writers.name: Malie library keeper
writers.quote: {first} sorted the old books in Malie. Quiet, sharp.

writers.name: Ex-Skull grunt Tupp's mum
writers.quote: {first} kept my boy out of trouble. Mostly. Bless them.

writers.name: Seafolk captain Mina's neighbour
writers.quote: {first} lived on the boat next door. Never stole a fish.
